claims.text: Vonoprazan: healing of erosive esophagitis 20 mg once daily for 8 weeks;
claims.quote: The recommended adult oral dosage is VOQUEZNA 20 mg once daily for 8 weeks for the treatment of healing of erosive esophagitis and relief of associated heartburn.

claims.text: maintenance 10 mg once daily for up to 6 months;
claims.quote: The recommended adult oral dosage is VOQUEZNA 10 mg once daily for up to 6 months for the maintenance of healed erosive esophagitis and relief of associated heartburn.

claims.text: non-erosive GERD heartburn 10 mg once daily for 4 weeks.
claims.quote: Relief of Heartburn Associated with Non-Erosive Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease: 10 mg once daily for 4 weeks.

claims.text: Vonoprazan is contraindicated with rilpivirine-containing products.
claims.quote: VOQUEZNA is contraindicated with rilpivirine-containing products

claims.text: Vonoprazan may raise exposure to CYP3A4 substrates;
claims.quote: Vonoprazan may increase exposure of CYP3A4 substrates, which may increase the risk of adverse reactions related to these substrates.

claims.text: a strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducer (eg, rifampicin, efavirenz) is predicted to lower vonoprazan exposure by 80% or 50%.
claims.quote: Vonoprazan exposures are predicted to be 80% lower when co-administered with a strong CYP3A4 inducer such as rifampicin and 50% lower when co-administered with a moderate CYP3A4 inducer such as efavirenz.
